news.title: Bernstein names Paytm stock as its top pick, lists 3 strong growth drivers for fintech giant
news.summary: Bernstein has named Paytm its top pick, citing strong merchant lending growth, operating leverage and potential UPI MDR as key earnings drivers. The brokerage has set a Rs 2,200 target, implying further upside, while flagging key downside risks.

news.title: Global Market: China, Hong Kong stocks fall as rate hike fears weigh on sentiment
news.summary: China and Hong Kong stocks fell on Friday, with the CSI300 and Hang Seng heading for weekly losses amid thin trading volumes, weaker liquidity and rising expectations of further US interest rate hikes. Mainland metal stocks led declines, while oil shares gained on stronger crude prices.

news.title: Global Market: China state insurers, banks to raise up to $54 billion to bolster capital
news.summary: China’s Ministry of Finance will inject up to $10.4 billion into five state-owned insurers as part of a broader plan to strengthen financial stability. The recapitalisation comes as tighter solvency rules and falling bond yields pressure insurers, while Beijing encourages greater equity investments.
